roleTitle: Fleet Analytics Analyst, Waste Collection Services
jobDescription: The waste collection company runs collection rounds for municipal contracts with a fleet of two hundred vehicles. The Fleet Analytics Analyst analyses the round telematics and the tipping data, proposes round changes with their expected mileage and time savings, prepares the monthly contract performance report, presents round changes to the depot managers, and documents each change's boundaries. Round change approvals stay with the operations director. The role requires presenting changes to depot managers who defend their existing rounds. Reports to the head of operations analytics; works with the depot managers, the telematics vendor and the contract managers.
requirements: Analyses round telematics and tipping data under the team's analysis procedure.
Proposes round changes with expected mileage and time effects, with approval staying with the operations director.
Prepares the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers.
Presents round changes to the depot managers and records their objections and the resolution.
Documents each change's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Fleet analytics analyst at a waste collection company for three years, analysing the round telematics and tipping data for the company's eleven depots under the team's analysis procedure.

Proposed thirty-four round changes with their expected mileage and time effects; the approvals were the operations director's, recorded on each proposal, and the post-change telematics confirmed the expected effect within the tolerance on twenty-nine of them.
Prepared the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers under the report template, filed in the contracts folder.
Presented each round change to the depot manager concerned in the depot review, with the depot review record listing the manager's objections and how each was resolved or carried to the director.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each round change proposal for the depot.

Work sample: two round change proposals with their approval records and post-change telematics, one monthly contract performance report and two depot review records, with the analytics platform references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 1 note: in the depot manager role-play, when the panel member objected that the proposed round ignored a school-run road closure, the candidate pulled up the closure window on the map, moved the affected stops to after the window, restated the revised time saving, and noted the objection and the revision on the proposal sheet.

Reference call with the former head of operations analytics: confirmed the candidate proposed the round changes and ran the depot reviews in the period, that approvals stayed with the operations director, and confirmed the dates.
